avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce immune system activation and potentially interfere with monoclonal antibody efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult oncologist before use

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase bleeding risk and interfere with immune response in cancer patients on biologic therapy
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to <400 IU/day or avoid; inform healthcare provider

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immunostimulatory effects may counteract intended immunotherapeutic action and increase adverse events

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: May support immune function; monitor for optimal levels during cancer treatment
caution_supplements.action: Use appropriate supplementation (800-2000 IU/day); discuss with oncology team

caution_supplements.name: Zinc
caution_supplements.mechanism: Essential for immune function; deficiency may worsen treatment-related complications
caution_supplements.action: Monitor levels; supplement if deficient (10-15 mg/day)

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May support gastrointestinal health during cancer therapy; variable evidence
caution_supplements.action: May use with medical guidance; choose clinical-grade products

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: While panitumumab is not hepatically metabolized, grapefruit may affect overall immune function and drug absorption; precautionary
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; maintain consistent intake if used

caution_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate fluid retention and hypertension risk associated with EGFR inhibitors
caution_foods.action: Maintain low-sodium diet; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: May impair immune function and increase gastrointestinal toxicity risk
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate consumption or avoid; discuss with oncologist

monitoring_notes: Panitumumab is a monoclonal antibody with minimal hepatic metabolism, so traditional drug interactions are limited. Monitor for immune-related adverse events (acneiform rash, diarrhea, hypomagnesemia, infusion reactions) and ensure adequate nutritional support. Regular assessment of EGFR mutation status and treatment response is essential.
